subject: VS texture support needs cross-owner retention fields; slot collisions
body: Render stage support must not reuse compositorTextures[slot]/compositorSamplers[slot] for both stages: Dispatch at compute_frontend.m332 has ONE shared array, so VS tex0 and FS tex0 different objects would overwrite/skip retention. Existing cleanup sites: compute_frontend.m1540-41 plus render_encoder.inc1530-31 and2000-01. Propose additive generic-retained arrays keyed native binding (<=16 textures and16samplers) or separate VS arrays, leaving old compositor arrays intact; compute owner adds fields/main cleanup, render owner populates/error-cleans. Also generic resources local array at render_encoder.inc1832 is sized62buffers+31textures+16samplers; offering both stages needs up to156 inputs (Rust accepts186), not109. Test same Metal slot number in both stages, release originals before completion, and error rollback no leak.
